mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 70 degrees and fair at Verona Community Park.

The City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election. All four Aldermanic District seats are up for election, and interested residents must submit their forms to the City Clerk by January 5, 2027.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, check out Yoga at Insight Wellness or Art House 360 festivities. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run or celebrate 50 years of craft brewing at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
In our weekly report, we look back to November 6, when officers were dispatched to a business on West Verona Avenue and arrested a woman for O W I after she was found passed out in her vehicle.
Culver's is currently open, but they are closing soon in just 55 minutes, so be sure to head over now to grab today's flavor of the day.
